name: Code Editor
tagline: Reads and changes a project's code, with its language's colours

offers.label: New file
offers.description: Starts a file called `name` in `folder`, holding `text`: what a person types in the project,

offers.label: New folder
offers.description: Starts a folder called `name` in `folder`.

offers.label: Open a project folder
offers.description: Opens the folder `folder` as the project: each file and folder it holds, read as entries,

offers.label: Save all
offers.description: Writes every file that changed here to the device.

offers.label: Run
offers.description: Runs `command` in the project's folder, as the terminal does: its output and its exit status

offers.label: Stop
offers.description: Stops the command that runs in the project now.

offers.label: Clear the terminal
offers.description: Erases the terminal's history.

offers.label: Open a terminal
offers.description: Opens the project's folder in the system's terminal: the shell a person runs by hand.

offers.label: Go to it
offers.description: Brings the caret to the place an item of a command's output names: the file is read if the

offers.label: Go to line
offers.description: Shows `line` of the file at `path`, counted from 0.

offers.label: Search the project
offers.description: Searches every file of the project for `needle`, the case of its letters aside unless

offers.label: Stop searching
offers.description: Stops the project search.

offers.label: Open the place
offers.description: Shows the place a search found: the file is read from the device when the project does not

offers.label: Language servers
offers.description: Turns language servers on or off, for the project.

offers.label: Format on save
offers.description: Turns formatting a file on save on or off.

offers.label: Try again
offers.description: Ends the language server, as a person pressing "Try again" after a failure does: the next

offers.label: Show the problems
offers.description: Shows the file's problems under the code, as the window's own key does anywhere in it.

offers.label: Show the terminal
offers.description: Shows the project's terminal under the code, as Ctrl+J does anywhere in the window.

offers.label: Show the search results
offers.description: Shows what the project search found under the code, as Ctrl+Shift+F does anywhere in the

offers.label: Ensure settings
offers.description: This person's settings, made by their own first change so they are theirs to read and write.

offers.label: Zoom in
offers.description: Shows the code one step larger: the editor's own text size, kept for the person on every

offers.label: Zoom out
offers.description: Shows the code one step smaller.

offers.label: Actual size
offers.description: Shows the code at its own size again.
